# Screenshot API

Screenshot API renders webpages and custom HTML as images, PDFs, videos, or extracted content and supports paid asynchronous bulk capture jobs.

Category: Design. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/screenshot-api/.

## Actions

- **Create Bulk CSV Job**: Upload a CSV file to start a paid asynchronous bulk screenshot job and return the provider's complete job acceptance payload containing…
- **Create Bulk JSON Job**: Start a paid asynchronous bulk screenshot job from up to 50 JSON request items and return the provider's complete job acceptance payload…
- **Download Bulk Results** (read-only): Download the processed result CSV for a completed paid bulk screenshot job UUID.
- **Get Bulk Job Status** (read-only): Get progress and success/failure counts for a paid asynchronous bulk screenshot job UUID.
- **Render Screenshot**: Render a webpage or custom HTML and return a stored image, PDF, or video URL plus optional extracted content links.
